duration.text: The Business Administration at Zhejiang Gongshang University is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/per year ￥ 25000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1) Notarized highest academic degree certificate and complete transcript (for graduates, provide a pre-graduation certificate); Certificates and transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be accompanied by their Chinese or English translations; Students must bring the original academic degree certificate when they register for classes. (2) Language proficiency certificate: For students applying for English-taught programs, except for those whose native language is English, they are required to provide an English proficiency certificate such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO (excluding TOEFL ITP scores) or proof of previous English-taught courses; for students applying for Chinese-taught programs, they must submit a certificate of the Chinese proficiency test at level 4 (HSK4) or above, or proof of previous Chinese-taught courses. (3) Passport. (4) 2-inch photo (Reference format for the photo: Color 2-inch bareheaded ID photo, white background, no border, head occupies 2/3 of the photo size, photo size should be no less than 320*240 pixels, aspect ratio of height to width is 4:3, file size is 100-500KB, JPG format). (5) Attachment: Foreigner's Physical Examination Form.pdf. This form is uniformly printed by the Chinese health quarantine department and needs to be filled out in either Chinese or English. Applicants must conduct the examination strictly in accordance with the items specified in the "Foreigner's Physical Examination Form". Any missing items, failure to attach a personal photo, absence of a seam seal on the photo, or absence of signatures and stamps from doctors and hospitals render the "Foreigner's Physical Examination Form" invalid. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months. The system submission of the application is sufficient for its validity. Please let the applicants determine the time for their physical examination accordingly. (6) Certificate of No Criminal Record. (7) Personal Resume. (8) Applicants under the age of 18 residing in China are required to submit the attached document: Parental Authorization Letter and Guardian Assurance Letter.pdf. The guardian must be an adult Chinese citizen residing in China. (9) Application fee receipt: A 400 RMB bank remittance receipt. (Regardless of whether you are admitted or not, the application fee will not be refunded.)

requirements.text: (1) Non-Chinese citizens who are in good physical and mental health (free from infectious diseases and physical or mental disorders that affect normal study) and have good conduct. 2) Educational Requirements: Applicants for undergraduate programs must have a high school diploma. (III) Language Requirements: Applicants for courses taught in English, except those whose native language is English, are required to provide proof of their English proficiency (such as TOEFL/IELTS/DUOLINGUO) or proof of previous English-language courses they have taken. (TOEFL ITP scores are not accepted.) 2. Students applying for the Chinese language program are required to submit a certificate of proficiency in the Chinese language at the HSK 4 level or above, or proof of having completed a previous stage of the Chinese language course. (4) Age requirement: For those applying to pursue a bachelor's degree, the age should generally not exceed 25 years old.
